segments.text: Allah once revealed Qur'an, to clear an innocent man, and expose the Muslim who framed him.
It happened in Madinah. A coat of armor had been stolen.
The thief was a Muslim. To bury his crime, he hid the armor in a Jewish neighbour's home, and accused him of the theft.
His people closed ranks around him. He is one of us, they said. Take his word over the word of a Jew.
And the Prophet, peace be upon him, was about to rule against the innocent man. Then the sky spoke.
We have revealed to you the Book in truth, to judge between people by what Allah has shown you. So do not be an advocate for the deceitful.
segments.arabicText: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِمَآ أَرَىٰكَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا تَكُن لِّلْخَآئِنِينَ خَصِيمًا

segments.text: And whoever earns a sin, then casts it upon someone innocent, has taken on a slander, and a clear sin.
segments.arabicText: وَمَن يَكْسِبْ خَطِيٓـَٔةً أَوْ إِثْمًا ثُمَّ يَرْمِ بِهِۦ بَرِيٓـًٔا فَقَدِ ٱحْتَمَلَ بُهْتَـٰنًا وَإِثْمًا مُّبِينًا

segments.text: The innocent walked free. The liar was exposed. Because Allah, the Most Just, takes no side but the truth.
